title: SQL migrations III: core business tables, alerts, status history, indexes; migration-from-clean validation
objective: Complete the schema conversion: parties, brokers/contacts, leads and assignments, quotes/versions/assignments/attachments metadata, follow-ups, pricing approvals, append-only status history tables, lead notes, alerts, user_alert_views — with all dashboard/SLA/aging indexes carried over — and prove the full migration set applies from a clean database (M-08, M-10).
scope: parties, brokers, broker_contacts (one primary contact constraint)
leads (pricing_approval_state, loss/withdrawal capture, follow-up tracking, source, intake_credential_id, last_activity_at, external ref), lead_assignments (slot-based), lead_notes
quotes, quote_versions (one current version discipline), quote_assignments, quote_attachments (metadata + storage_key, soft remove)
lead_status_history and quote_status_history (append-only, jsonb inputs payload, actor)
alerts (type, lead/quote refs, severity, premium_at_risk, created/resolved, uniqueness constraint preventing duplicate open alert per type+lead+quote), user_alert_views
All remaining indexes for tenant/date/status/broker/RM/region/aging/SLA/lost-reason access paths (N-04)
Full-set validation: supabase db reset from empty applies every migration cleanly; script scripts/db/validate-migrations (or npm run equivalent) added
implementation_details: Convert changelogs through 170-assignment-slots faithfully; all tenant-scoped tables here are LIST-partitioned on tenant_id with composite (tenant_id,id) PKs and tenant-inclusive uniques per A-12; extend the partition-creation function so it covers every partitioned table in the final schema.
Money columns numeric(18,2); jsonb only for history/audit payloads; timestamptz UTC.
quote_attachments.storage_key holds the tenant-prefixed Supabase Storage object key (bytes live in Storage per A-6); include soft-remove columns.
alerts uniqueness: partial unique index on open alerts (type, tenant_id, lead_id, quote_id) supporting the Job-3 reconciliation idempotency guarantee (spec 9.5).
Add any FKs deferred from T-004 (e.g., api_credentials.broker_id).

Deliver a migration-validation script that (1) resets a scratch local database, (2) asserts zero errors, (3) dumps and diffs the schema against a checked-in expected schema snapshot or the documented shape — used by CI in T-010.

integration: supabase db reset applies the complete migration set from clean without error, twice in a row (idempotent tooling path)
Partition function invoked for a synthetic tenant creates partitions across ALL partitioned tables; inserts route to the correct partition
Append-only expectations: status history rows insert; no UPDATE/DELETE path required by schema (trigger-based guards only if present in the reference schema)
Duplicate open alert for same type+lead is rejected by the unique index; resolved alerts do not block new open ones
Schema-shape comparison vs the .NET reference database across the full schema — empty or explained diff

history.message: Task generated by Planner from approved spec.md. Maps to M-08, M-10, N-04 indexes, section 11 core business + alerts model.
Delegated to Implementor. T-005 and T-011 run in parallel (supabase/migrations vs src/server/lib/auth+supabase). Orchestrator owns harness JSON.

8 migrations (parties, brokers, leads, quotes, quote_attachments, lead_workflow, alerts, search_indexes) + validate-migrations script (npm run db:validate). All 16 tables confirmed LIST(tenant_id) against the live reference DB; partition routing proven behaviourally via tableoid::regclass, and the alerts uniqueness violation re-run INSIDE the dedicated partition (a partition-local index gap would be invisible otherwise). alerts partial-unique mutation-tested with the catalog-correct/behaviourally-useless variant (plain quote_id instead of COALESCE(quote_id,0)): 3 red - this is the enforcement behind spec 9.5 Job-3 idempotency that T-033/T-034 depend on. Over-broad mutation (non-partial uniques, which passes every negative case) caught by positive boundary tests: 3 red. Parity diff empty; parity query strengthened to include numeric_precision/scale because udt_name alone reports bare 'numeric' and would let a money column drift off numeric(18,2) unnoticed. Honoured T-004's finding: NO FK added on api_credentials.broker_id (task file line stale); recorded in the brokers migration header. Append-only history verified NOT DB-enforced in the reference (zero triggers/rules; UPDATE physically succeeds) - tests assert the honest contract on both sides rather than pretending a guard exists. Deliberate strengthening: uq_quote_versions_current (allow-listed, target-only) - the reference enforces one-current-version only in ReviseQuoteCommandHandler, so concurrent revisions can commit two current versions and double-count quoted premium in every dashboard joining is_current.

Evaluator PASS. Ran real commands: supabase:reset 0; db:validate 0 (20/20 migrations applied twice, identical schema, snapshot match); npm test 30 files/493 tests 0 skipped; typecheck 0; lint 0; db:seed stub exits 1 as designed. Evaluator independently REPRODUCED the alerts COALESCE mutation (plain quote_id, catalog-correct/behaviourally useless): 3 tests red, restored, suite green - the spec 9.5 Job-3 idempotency enforcement is genuinely tested. db:validate proven to fail in BOTH directions plus the skip case: mutated snapshot exit 1 with first-diff context; broken migration exit 1 via reset error; silently-skipped file (zzz_*.sql, unapplied by CLI) exit 1 via applied-list scan. RULINGS: (1) uq_quote_versions_current RATIFIED - same governance class as uq_reference_items_tenant_list_canonical_key, real concurrency hole with premium double-counting consequence, target-only, allow-listed with staleness self-check, tested from both sides. (2) quotes.is_current open gap: fold into T-026 (quotes backend) as a NEW migration + parity allow-list entry - not a separate task; backfill caveat is a no-op locally (A-1 no production data) but keep the header note for deployed environments. (3) Append-only history handling CONFIRMED CORRECT: parity suite proves zero user triggers on BOTH live databases; spec/AC-008 do not require DB-level append-only enforcement (M-08 faithful conversion; task file says guards only if present in reference); adding a trigger would be an invisible-to-diff behavioural divergence. api_credentials.broker_id no-FK deviation from the stale task-file line honoured per T-004 finding, documented in brokers migration header. No secrets in migrations. No findings.
